status: Electrical and housing thermal engineering screen; path bounds are assumptions pending measurement
inverter_efficiency_basis: Separate engineering screen assumption, not a measured moteus efficiency; use actual motor shaft power, with physical belt losses already represented in the plant
phase_current_convention: Peak sinusoidal phase current gives copper=0.75*Rline-line*Iq^2; if catalog current is RMS, double copper
stator_capacity_basis: Credit only adopted 34g stator at conservative copper heat capacity; ignore rotor/housing thermal capacity and do not credit chassis conduction
thermal_path_basis: Unqualified range including winding-to-case contact plus natural cooling inside housing; report required path and temperatures, not a claimed thermal pass
catalog_insulation_class: F (155C class; design screen keeps 30C hot-spot margin)
regen_basis: At full charge assume zero battery acceptance; gross negative mechanical work is a winding/dump upper bound. Net estimate subtracts simultaneous positive motor work, copper and 6W auxiliary load. M9 dump thermal and software flux-brake response remain unqualified
